propositions: LLMUnavailableError from epic-close bug screen per-candidate calls is currently degraded to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating to fail the close
a systematic provider error (all 32 per-candidate calls fail with the same Bedrock ValidationException) is silently converted to PASS with no signal in verdict, sidecar, or exit code
max_tokens raised for a larger model is never re-clamped when resolving to a smaller model, causing Bedrock 400 errors

the completion verifier must FAIL CLOSED (nonzero exit, block the close, keep ticket in_progress) on LLMUnavailableError, consistent with absent-provider behavior, with --force-close as the escape hatch
LLMUnavailableError must be re-raised before degradation at both screen_candidates._row and run_screen layers instead of being caught by broad per-candidate and advisory exception handlers
